name: Grain
one_liner: Meeting recorder (grain.com) with transcripts, AI notes, recordings and clips.
auth_notes: Personal Access Token (any plan), Workspace Access Token (admin, Business/Enterprise), OAuth2 for distributed integrations; sent as Authorization: Bearer plus Public-Api-Version header.
access_notes: PAT generated in account settings on every plan incl. Free; workspace-wide tokens need admin on Business/Enterprise. Third-party Scalekit claims Free has no API access, contradicted by Grain's own support page.

buildability.rationale: Versioned REST API v2 with webhooks and 300 req/min per token. PAT is self-serve but per-user; workspace tokens need paid admin; OAuth app registration unverified; no sandbox.

needs_human_reason: developers.grain.com sub-pages returned AccessDenied; endpoint count comes from third-party Scalekit; OAuth client registration and MCP URL not verified on vendor pages.

disputes.why: Developer quick start shows REST paths like GET api.grain.com/_/public-api/v2/token-info with version header; no GraphQL evidence.
Third-party Scalekit counts about two dozen API endpoints.
Quick start sends tokens as Authorization: Bearer.
Third-party Scalekit states OAuth 2.0 Authorization Code with PKCE.
No official SDK found in any fetched vendor page.

auth.quote: Every request needs a token in the Authorization header and a Public-Api-Version
OAuth 2.0 access token obtained via Authorization Code with PKCE

access.quote: Not for personal API access, which is available on every plan, including Free.

sandbox.quote: No sandbox is available at this time.

api_surface.quote: The API's two dozen endpoints include webhooks, media upload and download, and sharing.
The API allows 300 requests per minute per token.

mcp.quote: Grain launched its official remote MCP server on June 18, 2025, and it is available to every Grain plan.

buildability.quote: Requires admin access to generate and is available on Business and Enterprise plans.

identity.quote: The Grain API lets you read and manage recordings, highlights, uploads, and more.
